stem: Which statement about metformin and type 1 diabetes matches MedlinePlus?

options.label: A
options.text: Metformin is an ACE inhibitor for type 1 diabetes only
options.misconception: Wrong class — does not match the cited teaching point.
options.explanation: Metformin is a biguanide, not ACEI.

options.label: B
options.text: Metformin is a salicylate antiplatelet for type 1 diabetes only
options.misconception: Wrong class — does not match the cited teaching point.

options.label: C
options.text: Metformin is not used to treat type 1 diabetes
options.explanation: MedlinePlus: not used to treat type 1 diabetes.

options.label: D
options.text: Metformin is first-line rescue for type 1 DKA alone
options.explanation: False claim; see the cited source passage for detail.

options.label: E
options.text: Metformin replaces insulin in all type 1 patients
options.explanation: False claim; see the cited source passage for detail.

context: Learning objective: metformin not for type 1.
